# Active workflow scope

This repository has no product deployment workflow. SmartLic is limited to
migration evidence, URL-specific redirect planning, incident containment,
retention/security duties and repository decommissioning.

`runtime-authority-guard.yml` prevents new executable Railway, Supabase or
SmartLic production-deploy commands. Test and static-analysis workflows do not
authorize a runtime.

Canonical public deployment belongs to `tjsasakifln/web-cfg` and
`confenge.com.br`.
